scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @writer-agent/contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter @writer-agent/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @writer-agent/web typecheck

scripts.openapi:generate: pnpm --filter @writer-agent/api exec tsx ../../scripts/build-notes-openapi.mts && pnpm --filter @writer-agent/api exec tsx ../../scripts/build-review-openapi.mts && node scripts/build-openapi-candidate.mjs && pnpm --filter @writer-agent/api exec tsx ../../scripts/build-publication-openapi.mts

scripts.openapi:lint: pnpm exec redocly lint harness/contracts/api-spec-v0.4.0-proposed.yaml && pnpm exec redocly lint harness/contracts/publication-api-v1.json

scripts.test:publication: pnpm --filter @writer-agent/contracts build && pnpm build:api:go && node scripts/test-publication-api.mjs
